pricePolicy: Suggested spending ranges, not verified Amazon prices. Search links let you choose your size and seller. Check delivery to your PIN code.

items.title: 10 L roll-top dry bag
items.detail: For boat rides, kayak and a dry change. Choose sealed seams; test it empty and keep it above water.
items.amazonQuery: 10 litre roll top waterproof dry bag sealed seams

items.title: Long-sleeve swim / rash top
items.detail: For the three activity mornings. Look for labelled UPF 50+ swim fabric and a comfortable fit.
items.amazonQuery: men full sleeve swimming rash guard UPF 50

items.title: Quick-dry swim shorts
items.detail: Alternate pairs over three consecutive water-activity mornings. Reuse your existing swimwear.
items.amazonQuery: men quick dry swimming shorts drawstring

items.title: Water-resistant SPF 50 sunscreen
items.detail: Use one that suits your skin and the operator’s rules; replenish as needed. Example: Neutrogena Ultra Sheer SPF 50+ PA++++.
items.amazonQuery: Neutrogena Ultra Sheer sunscreen SPF 50 PA 80g

items.title: Quick-dry travel towel
items.detail: A body-size towel for the three activity days. Check dimensions: a small gym hand towel won’t do the same job.
items.amazonQuery: microfiber quick dry travel towel 140 70 cm

items.title: Mosquito repellent
items.detail: For the pre-dawn kayak, Baratang and evenings. Pick one you tolerate; follow its label.

items.title: Sun hat or cap
items.detail: For beaches, jetty waits and boat rides. A secure fit or chin cord helps.
items.amazonQuery: sun hat wide brim chin strap men

items.title: Bags for wet swimwear
items.detail: Keep damp clothes separate on ferry and hotel changes. Reuse zip bags you already have.
items.amazonQuery: reusable waterproof wet clothes bag travel

groups.title: Only if missing · reuse or share

items.title: Grippy footwear
items.detail: Use broken-in trainers for caves and rocky paths; sandals for beaches. Buy only if your existing pair won’t work.
items.amazonQuery: outdoor sandals men anti slip heel strap

items.title: 10,000 mAh USB-C power bank
items.detail: For long cab and ferry days. Reuse a working one; Ambrane Force 10K is one example of wired USB-C PD.
items.amazonQuery: Ambrane Force 10K 10000mAh power bank USB C PD

items.title: Small torch / headlamp
items.detail: For Baratang and walking to pre-dawn pickups. Coordinate before buying five; follow the kayak guide’s lighting instructions on the water.

items.title: Light rain layer
items.detail: Pack a poncho or lightweight rain jacket you own. A heavy trekking jacket isn’t needed for this plan.

items.title: UV-protective sunglasses
items.detail: For bright beach and boat days. Look for labelled UV400 / UV protection.

items.title: Small first-aid pouch
items.detail: Plasters, gauze, tape and cleansing wipes. Bring personal prescribed medicines separately.
items.amazonQuery: small first aid pouch bandages gauze tape wipes

packFromHome: 5–6 light tops, 2 everyday shorts, 1 light trouser, 8 underwear, 3 pairs of socks and sleepwear.
A small daypack, refillable water bottle, phone charger, cables and toiletries.
Original photo ID, offline document wallet, payment cards / cash and your personal medicines.
skip: Skip a new suitcase, action camera or personal snorkel set for this trip unless you already wanted one. Turquoise Dream includes snorkelling equipment; a phone pouch is optional and isn’t a diving case.
